recap.analyst:
Harbor City beat Lombardia Nord 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.70–1.05: the scoreline flatters Harbor City, who were second-best on chance quality.

Harbor City had 59% of the ball. Pass completion HAR 80% (152/189), LOM 78% (114/147). Shots 6–9, on target 0–0.

Harbor City started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Lombardia Nord in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: LOM to 4-2-3-1 at 77' (chasing the game); HAR to 5-4-1 at 79' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 75': An own goal by D. Guerreiro The chance was worth xG 0.22 (about 22 in 100 go in), struck at 100 km/h. Score now HAR 1-0 LOM. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: B. Fuentes completed the most passes (31); A. Garrido hit the top speed (33.2 km/h); A. Lindgren covered the most ground (6.17 km, a 17.7 km per-90 pace); P. Reyes won the most challenges (17).

Discipline: fouls 6–3, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: partly cloudy, 24°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at The Arch, London. An own goal opened the scoring in the 75th minute, and Harbor City were ahead. Lombardia Nord pushed for a way back, switching to a 4-2-3-1 in the 77th minute, but Harbor City held firm. The hero: P. Reyes, with 18 completed passes and 17 tackles. At the final whistle, Harbor City celebrate in front of their fans.
